a: GET read, POST create, PUT replace, PATCH update, DELETE remove.
201 Created means a new resource was successfully created.
204 No Content means success with an empty body, common after DELETE.
422 Unprocessable Entity often means validation failed.
429 Too Many Requests means rate limited; back off and retry.
502 Bad Gateway means a proxy got an invalid response from upstream.
504 Gateway Timeout means upstream took too long.
GET, PUT, DELETE are idempotent; POST generally is not.
Safe methods (GET, HEAD) should not change server state.
Clients use Accept headers to request JSON vs HTML etc.
